response.original_title: (((FAQ!!^39)) How do I add a room on a Regent Seven Seas?
response.overview: To add a Room to an existing Regent Seven Seas cruise booking +1-[866]-381-[3303] , please contact Customer Service at +1-[866]-381-[3303] (US) or 44-808-196-9697 (UK) for assistance with checking state Room availability and updating the reservation. A representative can guide you through the available options and provide 1-(866)-381-3303 (US) or & +44-808-196-9697(UK) information about applicable rates, Room categories, and booking requirements. If the reservation was made through a travel advisor, please contact the advisor for further assistance.
